annotations.title: What needs my office's attention today?

description: Use when a lawyer or staff member asks "what needs my attention today?". Returns the office's real list: overdue tasks, inquiries waiting for a reply, appointments, documents to review and prepared drafts, each with why it is listed and where it came from, plus what is not connected. Never add items, deadlines or advice of your own. For a lawyer or staff member of a law office signed in to ESQ CoPilot for their office. Do not call it for a person looking for a lawyer (use search_attorneys) or for general legal questions.
name: get_office_briefing
